  $End_Date := $moment($state.context.CONSTANTS.masterDataFlowConfiguration.requestedFlow.filters.modifiedBefore.formattedDate).format('YYYY/MM/DD');
  
  $query := 'SELECT TOP ' & $Top_N & '
    SA.Supplier_No,

    SA.Supplier_Address_Code,
    SAT.Supplier_Address_Type_Key,
    SA.[Address],
    SA.City,
    SA.[State] AS State,
    SA.Zip,
    SAT.Supplier_Address_Type_Code,
    C.Country AS Country,
    SA.Country_Key,
    SA.Resource_Id,
    SA.Main,
    Parent_S.Supplier_No AS Parent_Supplier_No,
    Child_S.Supplier_Status
  FROM Common_v_Supplier_Address_e AS SA
  JOIN Common_v_Supplier_Address_Type_e AS SAT
    ON SA.PCN = SAT.PCN
   AND SA.Supplier_Address_Type_Key = SAT.Supplier_Address_Type_Key
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Common_v_Country AS C
    ON C.Country_Key = SA.Country_Key
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Common_v_State AS S
    ON S.[State] = SA.[State] AND
    S.Country_Key = C.Country_Key
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Common_v_Supplier_e AS Child_S
    ON Child_S.Plexus_Customer_No = SA.PCN
    AND Child_S.Supplier_No = SA.Supplier_No
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Common_v_Supplier_e AS Parent_S

    AND Parent_S.Supplier_No = Child_S.Parent_Supplier_No
  WHERE SA.PCN = ?
    AND SA.Supplier_Address_Key > ?
    AND
      COALESCE(SA.Updated_Date, SA.Add_Date, GETDATE()) >= ?
    AND

  ORDER BY SA.PCN, SA.Supplier_Address_Key ASC';

        $Begin_Date,
        $End_Date

      "options": {
